candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {r : Nat} {d : Fin r → Nat} (X : Type u_2) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} X]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k X] [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_2} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) X]
  [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (MatProd.{u_1} k d) X] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k X]
  [∀ (i : Fin r), NeZero.{0} (d i)],
  Exists.{1} fun m =>
    Nonempty.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
      (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1} (RingHom.id.{u_1} (MatProd.{u_1} k d)) X
        (DirectSum.{0, u_1} (Fin r) fun i => Fin (m i) → Fin (d i) → k))
